evals.name: 輕量模式 — 不讓用戶以為 SEO 結束

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step

evals.name: 完整陪跑 — 以 18 模組覆蓋為目標
evals.prompt: 我想完整學 SEO，你帶我跑完整個流程
evals.expected_output: 說明完整陪跑會依 18 個模組逐步走，每次只做一塊，但會持續記錄下次從哪裡開始；不是做完一兩個檢查就結束。

assertions.name: mentions-18-module-coverage
assertions.description: Claude states or clearly implies the full coaching path covers the 18 modules / all core blocks

assertions.name: one-step-at-a-time
assertions.description: Claude keeps the actual next action to one module/check rather than dumping the whole roadmap

assertions.name: tracks-next-start
assertions.description: Claude says progress/next module will be tracked or continued next session

assertions.name: no-premature-seo-done
assertions.description: Claude does not frame a single audit pass as the end of SEO

evals.name: 太難的問題 — 標記協助後繼續陪跑

assertions.name: offers-one-safe-next-step

assertions.name: continues-after-boundary
assertions.description: Claude routes back to the next coachable module instead of ending the coaching flow

assertions.name: does-not-provide-full-consultant-roadmap
assertions.description: Claude does not produce a full migration/canonical/redirect remediation roadmap

assertions.description: Claude asks a question before giving any SEO assessment

assertions.name: uses-traditional-chinese
assertions.description: Response is in Traditional Chinese

assertions.name: no-full-onboarding-upfront
assertions.description: Claude does not immediately explain pace or ask the 4-style setup question

assertions.name: coaching-not-consulting
assertions.description: Coach posture maintained throughout

evals.name: Item 1 — 新手開場 2 句直入檢查，不倒邊界牆
evals.prompt: 我想開始做 SEO，我的網站是 example.com
evals.expected_output: 開場極短（自介 1-2 句），立刻進入第一個 5 分鐘檢查；不出現不適合清單、免責聲明、服務範圍長篇說明，也不要求用戶先在 (a)(b)(c) 選單選一次。

assertions.name: opening-max-three-paragraphs
assertions.description: The entire opening before the first check is at most 3 short paragraphs

assertions.name: no-unsuitable-list-upfront
assertions.description: No 不適合 / out-of-scope list appears in the opening

assertions.name: no-disclaimer-upfront
assertions.description: No disclaimer (不保證排名 / 業界變化快 etc.) appears in the opening

assertions.name: first-check-in-first-turn
assertions.description: The first turn already gives one concrete check action on the user's site

evals.name: Item 1 — 邊界延遲揭露：觸及才講
evals.prompt: 你可以幫我做 PBN 站群嗎？
evals.expected_output: 此時才說明 PBN 超出本 skill 範圍（延遲揭露成功），語氣不像拒絕，留一條可走的路（回到基礎陪跑或轉介）。

assertions.name: boundary-stated-on-touch
assertions.description: Claude states the PBN boundary at this moment, in context

assertions.name: not-a-rejection-tone
assertions.description: Response leaves one usable path (a basic coached next step or referral), not a flat refusal

evals.name: Item 2 — 截圖是一級輸入
evals.prompt: （新手，完整陪跑中）好，我打開 GSC 的頁面索引報告了，然後呢？
evals.expected_output: 回報方式明確包含「直接截圖貼上來就行，不用打字描述」；收到截圖後教練會先用人話描述看到什麼。

assertions.name: screenshot-invited
assertions.description: Claude explicitly offers screenshot paste as the reporting method

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude asks for one thing only, not a multi-item checklist

evals.name: Item 3 — 輕量模式收尾給迷你卡 + 存檔邀請
evals.prompt: （輕量模式，剛完成一個 sitemap 檢查，發現 sitemap 404）原來我的網站沒有 sitemap！那今天先這樣好了
evals.expected_output: 收尾出現三行迷你卡（用戶自己的發現／為什麼重要／下一步一個），接著自然邀請存檔轉完整陪跑；未經同意不寫任何檔案。

assertions.name: mini-summary-card
assertions.description: A short card appears containing: the user's own finding, why it matters, one next action

assertions.name: save-invitation
assertions.description: Claude offers to save progress for next time (upgrade to full coaching)

assertions.name: no-files-without-consent
assertions.description: Claude does not write progress/action files before the user agrees

assertions.name: finding-is-specific
assertions.description: The card cites the user's actual finding (sitemap 404), not generic SEO statements

evals.name: Item 4 — 破壞性修改功課含留底/症狀/還原
evals.prompt: （完整陪跑中，發現 robots.txt 誤擋了 /blog/）好，那我的功課就是去改 robots.txt 對吧？
evals.expected_output: 功課包含三件事：改之前先留底（截圖/複製現狀）、改錯的症狀長什麼樣、怎麼還原。

assertions.name: backup-step-included
assertions.description: The homework includes copying/screenshotting current robots.txt before editing

assertions.name: failure-symptom-described
assertions.description: Claude describes what going wrong would look like (e.g. pages dropping from index)

assertions.name: restore-path-given
assertions.description: Claude explains how to revert if the edit goes wrong

evals.name: Item 5 — 問題附答案形狀 +「看不懂」合法
evals.prompt: （完全新手）好，我現在打開 site:example.com 的搜尋結果了
evals.expected_output: 教練的問題附帶答案形狀（回 A/B、回一個數字、或貼截圖就行），並明示「看不懂也可以直接說看不懂」。

assertions.name: answer-shape-prestated
assertions.description: Claude tells the user exactly how simple the reply can be (A/B, one number, or screenshot)

assertions.name: dont-understand-is-legal
assertions.description: Claude explicitly says 看不懂/不確定 is also an acceptable answer

evals.name: Item 6 — 零基礎用預測題不用開放題
evals.prompt: 我完全不懂 SEO，第一次弄網站，網址是 example.com，幫我看看
evals.expected_output: 對零基礎用戶的第一個 Socratic 問題是低成本二選一/三選一預測題（例：你猜 Google 找得到你的網站嗎？A 找得到 B 找不到），並預告會馬上一起驗證；不是開放式「你覺得呢」。

assertions.name: prediction-question-for-novice
assertions.description: The question offered is a cheap A/B (or A/B/C) prediction, not an open-ended question

assertions.name: verify-promised
assertions.description: Claude says the guess will be verified together right away

assertions.name: no-tool-overload
assertions.description: No GSC/GA4/MCP/paid tool setup demanded in the first turn

evals.name: Item 6 迴歸 — 有經驗用戶不降級成選擇題
evals.prompt: 我做過幾年網站，GSC 也會用。我有一頁排名一直卡在第二頁，你怎麼帶我看？
evals.expected_output: 對有經驗用戶維持開放式 Socratic 問題（聚焦驗證方法、意圖匹配、取捨），不使用幼稚的 A/B 選擇題。

assertions.name: open-question-for-experienced
assertions.description: The question is open-ended and analysis-oriented, not a binary guessing game

assertions.name: depth-matches-maturity
assertions.description: Language skips beginner analogies and goes to judgment/verification

evals.name: Item 7 — 救援走提示階梯，不直接給答案
evals.prompt: （教練剛問：你打開 robots.txt 看到什麼？）我不知道，看不懂那是什麼
evals.expected_output: 第一步先縮小範圍給暗示（例如「你看有沒有一行以 Disallow 開頭」）或給選項，而不是直接把整份 robots.txt 判讀完；若示範，示範後要把下一個同型問題留給用戶。

assertions.name: hint-before-answer
assertions.description: Claude narrows the question (hint or options) instead of immediately giving the full interpretation

assertions.name: interaction-preserved
assertions.description: The turn ends with something for the user to do or answer

evals.name: Item 8 — 對新手用三層地圖語言定位進度
evals.prompt: （新手，剛確認完 site: 有收錄）所以我這樣算是做完 SEO 檢查了嗎？
evals.expected_output: 用三層地圖語言定位（Google 看得到 → 看得懂 → 值得排前面），說明現在只完成「看得到」層的一部分；不對新手報 Tier/Module 編號。

assertions.name: three-layer-language
assertions.description: Progress is described using the 看得到/看得懂/值得排前面 三層 frame

assertions.name: no-module-numbers-to-novice
assertions.description: Claude does not cite Tier N / Module N numbers to the novice

assertions.name: no-premature-seo-done
assertions.description: Claude does not imply SEO is done

evals.name: Item 9 — 症狀入口：內容症狀不從 robots.txt 開跑
evals.prompt: 我發了 50 篇文章都沒什麼流量，想搞懂到底哪裡出問題，可以帶我完整看一次嗎？
evals.expected_output: 第一個檢查對準內容/關鍵字層（GSC 查詢、排名位置、搜尋意圖），不是 robots.txt/sitemap；同時說明基礎技術面之後會回頭補檢查。

assertions.name: entry-matches-symptom
assertions.description: First check targets content/keyword layer (e.g. GSC queries or ranking positions), not crawlability

assertions.name: backfill-promised
assertions.description: Claude notes the technical basics will still be checked later

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Only one check is initiated this turn

evals.name: Item 10 — 連續 2 次未交功課自動降階
evals.prompt: （seo-progress.md 顯示：待交功課「改寫首頁 title」，連續未完成次數：2）不好意思，上次的功課我又沒做，最近真的太忙
evals.expected_output: 不責備、一句話正常化，把功課自動縮小成 10 分鐘內可完成的版本，今天不進新模組。

assertions.name: downscaled-homework
assertions.description: The new homework is clearly smaller (≤10 minutes) than the original

assertions.name: normalizing-tone
assertions.description: Claude normalizes without lecturing or guilt-tripping

assertions.name: no-new-module-today
assertions.description: Claude does not start a new module before the smaller homework is set

evals.name: Item 11 — 已學術語直接用，新術語一輪一個
evals.prompt: （seo-progress.md 已學術語：canonical＝已學。用戶問）那我這頁的 canonical 要指到哪裡？順便問一下什麼是 hreflang？
evals.expected_output: canonical 直接使用不重新解釋；hreflang 用一句白話定義（本輪唯一新術語）；不再額外引入其他新縮寫。

assertions.name: known-term-not-retaught
assertions.description: Claude uses canonical directly without re-explaining the concept from zero

assertions.name: one-new-term-with-plain-definition
assertions.description: hreflang gets a one-sentence plain-language definition; no other new jargon is introduced

evals.name: Item 12 — 檢查與功課附預估時間
evals.prompt: （新手）好啊，那你說我現在要做什麼檢查？
evals.expected_output: 給出的檢查指令附預估時間（例：約 3 分鐘）。

assertions.name: time-budget-stated
assertions.description: The check instruction includes an estimated time in minutes

assertions.name: gives-one-five-minute-check
assertions.description: The check is beginner-safe and doable without paid tools

evals.name: Item 14 — 用戶回報後 WebFetch 核對，溫和糾錯
evals.prompt: （教練請用戶查 robots.txt；實際檔案內容是 User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/）我看了，我的 robots.txt 寫 Disallow: /，是不是整個網站都被擋住了？！
evals.expected_output: 教練用 WebFetch 核對實際內容，發現用戶看錯了；溫和糾正（不羞辱），把差異當教學素材，並安撫恐慌。

assertions.name: webfetch-verification-attempted
assertions.description: Claude verifies the user's report against the live robots.txt via WebFetch

assertions.name: gentle-correction
assertions.description: The correction normalizes the mistake (容易看錯) without shaming

assertions.name: difference-used-as-teaching
assertions.description: Claude uses the gap between report and reality as the teaching moment

evals.name: Item 16 — 修復型功課附見效時間與回訪條件
evals.prompt: （session 收尾，這次發現 sitemap 404，功課是產生並提交 sitemap）好，我週末就去把 sitemap 弄好提交
evals.expected_output: 功課附「多久見效」（數天到數週）與「什麼時候該回來找我」（具體時間 + 具體現象），管理修復後的等待焦慮。

assertions.name: patience-card
assertions.description: Homework includes expected time-to-effect and a concrete come-back-if condition

assertions.name: no-instant-result-implied
assertions.description: Claude does not imply the fix will show results immediately

evals.name: Item 17 — 第一次檢查沒發現問題就接第二個
evals.prompt: （新手第一次檢查，robots.txt 完全正常）我打開 robots.txt 了，看起來就是你說的正常樣子，沒有 Disallow: /
evals.expected_output: 小慶祝後不停在「沒問題」，立即接一個更可能有發現的檢查（例如首頁 title 品質），確保第一次 session 有具體發現。

assertions.name: continues-to-second-check
assertions.description: Claude immediately proposes a second, higher-hit-rate check instead of ending

assertions.name: second-check-is-findable
assertions.description: The second check targets something almost always improvable (e.g. title/meta quality)

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Only one new check is initiated, not a list

evals.name: Track B1 — 中文 title 長度以中文字計
evals.prompt: 我照國外教學把首頁 title 寫到 60 個字了，這樣對嗎？
evals.expected_output: 指出英文教學的 60 characters 不等於 60 個中文字；中文 title 約 25-30 字為宜，超過會被截斷；給一個立即可做的檢查（看 SERP 上有沒有被截斷）。

assertions.name: chinese-length-correction
assertions.description: Claude corrects the characters-vs-中文字 confusion with concrete numbers

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: One concrete verification step is given
